title: eludite.forge.issue_create input
description: Create an issue (Azure DevOps: a work item of `type`, default the process's bug or issue type) with labels, assignees and milestone where the forge supports them. For an agent, under the solution policy's `forge.write`: `prompt` (the default) makes the first write of an agent session dangerous (the Agents window asks; "Allow for this session" holds until the session ends), `allow` runs it, `deny` refuses it. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

items.description: A label's name (a tag on Azure DevOps).
A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.

type.description: Azure DevOps: the work item type.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
